title: cecal bacteria DNA extraction
author: Shiu-Ming Kuo

steps_raw.instruction: Isolating genomic DNA from Gram Positive and Gram Negative bacteria in cecum
turn on heating block at setting 6.6 to get to 80°C.
1) Weigh out cecum material (use the vial for the Kontes Pellet Pestle). Calculate how much 0.9% NaCL is required. Dilution ratio of 1:10 of fecal material to 0.9% NaCl.
2) Using autoclaved pipet to add 0.9% NaCl solution into the vials with the cecum material. If the volume is more than 0.5 ml, mix briefly with pipet and split the volume to two vials.
3) Homogenize with Kontes Pellet Pestle Motor in ice bath for 30 seconds each with up and down motion. Until no visible particles. Smaller volume may be shorter (20 sec).
4) Centrifuge solution for 5 minutes at 900xg (eppendorf in cold room)
5) Extract the supernatant to a new 1.5 ml vial. OD650 see step 10.
6) Centrifuge at 15,000x g for 2 minutes to pellet the cells. Remove the supernatant completely with a transfer pipet and a 10μL pipet and save the pellet.
13) Resuspend the cells in 480μL of 50mM EDTA.
14) Add 6 µl 14286 unit/ml mutanolysin and 120 µl 40 mg lysozyme/ml, and resuspend with lysozyme pipet gently to mix. This will weaken the bacteria cell wall so effective cell lysis can occur.
15) Incubate the sample at 37°C for 1 hour (use ThermoKool). Mix gently every 10 min.
16) Centrifuge at 15,000x g for 2 min (Eppendorf cold room) to pellet the cells and remove the supernatant.
17) Add 600μL of Nuclei Lysis Solution (NOT cell lysis solution). Gently pipet solution to resuspend cells
18) Incubate at 80°C for 5 minutes to lyse the cells; cool to room temperature.
19) Add 3μL of RNase Solution to the cell lysate. Mix by inverting the tube 2-5 times. Incubate at 37°C for 15 minutes.
20) Cool the sample to room temperature. Centrifuge briefly to bring the solution down.
21) Add 200μL of Protein Precipitation Solution to the RNase-treated cell lysate. Vortex vigorously at high speed for 40 seconds (turn white+30sec).
22) Incubate the sample on ice for 5 minutes.
23) Centrifuge at 15,000x g for 3 minutes (Eppendorf cold room)
24) Transfer 700µl supernatant containing the DNA to a new 1.5mL centrifuge tube containing 600μL of room temperature isopropanol.
25) Gently mix by hand inversion (10times) Rotator for 10 min and then -20°C for 4 hours.
26) Centrifuge at 15,000 x g for 3 minutes.

27) Carefully pour the supernatant off and drain the tube on clean absorbent paper. Add 600μL of room temperature 70% ethanol and gently invert the tube several times to wash the DNA pellet and the inner surface of vial.
28) Centrifuge at 13,000-16,000 x g for 3 minutes. Dump 70% ethanol.
29) Repeat step 27-28. Drain the tube on a clean absorbent paper and allow the pellet to air-dry for 10-15 minutes. Laminar hood for 5 additional min is helpful.

30) Add 20 uL of DNAse,RNAse-free water to the tube and rehydrate the DNA by incubating at 65°C for 1 hour (and then 5 hours at RT). Periodically mix the solution by gently tapping the tube. Alternatively, rehydrate the DNA by incubating the solution overnight at 4°C.
31) Store the DNA at 2-8°C.
